jobs.label: GloRe Graph Reasoning Unit
jobs.purpose: Project C4 pixels to an interaction graph, reason over graph nodes, and reproject the result.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4; Aligned remains the subsequent C1/C4 fusion
jobs.cost: low-medium; +47,232 parameters over W128 in wave6 and low-resolution graph operations
jobs.risk: Wave6 reduced false positives but increased false negatives relative to W128; interaction with Aligned may over-correct recall.
jobs.expected: Best evidence-backed efficiency addition: wave6 recovered +0.001031 crack-IoU and +0.000733 F1 over W128 while staying below 0.95x B0 parameters.

jobs.label: Separable Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling
jobs.purpose: Aggregate several dilation scales on projected C4 before flow alignment.
jobs.location: projected C4 at 1/32, immediately before AlignedModule
jobs.cost: medium; +104,448 parameters over W128 in wave6; depthwise-separable spatial branches
jobs.risk: Likely exceeds the strict 0.95x parameter target with the Aligned parent; dilation may blur very thin cracks.
jobs.expected: Wave6 recovered +0.001036 crack-IoU and +0.006635 BF1 over W128, making it the strongest boundary-aware backup to GloRe.

jobs.label: Context Encoding Module
jobs.purpose: Learn residual codeword assignments and use them for channel-wise semantic recalibration.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4; use the second forward output
jobs.cost: medium; +136,784 parameters over W128 in wave6
jobs.risk: Parameter target is missed and codeword statistics may overfit the repeatedly used validation distribution.
jobs.expected: Wave6 improved BF1 by +0.007570 over W128, but regional gains were nearly neutral.

jobs.label: RTFormer External Attention
jobs.purpose: Use learned external key/value memories instead of a quadratic pixel-to-pixel affinity matrix.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4, with the residual addition used by RTFormer EABlock
jobs.cost: low; about two 256x64 projections plus normalization, and no HW-by-HW matrix
jobs.risk: Standalone use omits the rest of EABlock's MLP and dual-resolution stream; benefit may be small.
jobs.expected: Good strict-budget candidate with global mixing and lower attention cost than NonLocal/PAM.

jobs.label: BiSeNetV2 Context Embedding Block
jobs.purpose: Inject global pooled context into C4, followed by local 3x3 refinement.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4
jobs.cost: high parameters but low spatial runtime; the 256-channel 3x3 convolution is the dominant cost
jobs.risk: Likely exceeds B0's parameter count and overlaps semantically with GC/SE-style global pooling.
jobs.expected: Potentially improves continuity with stable low-resolution compute, but is unlikely to satisfy the parameter objective.

jobs.label: Disentangled Non-Local Block
jobs.source: paddleseg/models/dnlnet.py::DisentangledNonLocal2D(temperature=0.05, in_channels=256, reduction=4, use_scale=True, sub_sample=False, mode='embedded_gaussian'); forward(x)->x
jobs.purpose: Separate unary context and centered pairwise relations in global C4 attention.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4
jobs.cost: medium; reduced 64-channel global affinity at 1/32 resolution
jobs.risk: Closely related to NonLocal and may repeat its high-recall/poor-boundary behavior; quadratic spatial attention remains.
jobs.expected: More targeted successor to NonLocal, with a chance to retain its IoU while correcting affinity bias.

jobs.label: PP-LiteSeg Simple Pyramid Context Module
jobs.purpose: Sum lightweight pooled context branches before Aligned fusion.
jobs.location: projected C4 at 1/32, immediately before AlignedModule
jobs.cost: low; three 128-to-32 pool projections and one 32-to-128 3x3 projection
jobs.risk: The local source contains a Windows/RTX50 interpolation compatibility path; this must be disclosed and frozen with the snapshot.
jobs.expected: One of the most plausible strict-parameter candidates for recovering global continuity without a heavy decoder.

jobs.label: DDRNet Deep Aggregation Pyramid Pooling Module
jobs.purpose: Progressively aggregate four pooled scales with residual compression.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4
jobs.cost: medium; several pooled 3x3 branches and roughly 0.18M parameters
jobs.risk: C4 is only about 13x13 at crop 400, so its 5/9/17 pooling kernels may collapse distinct scales and add normalization noise.
jobs.expected: Could improve long-crack continuity, but probably fits the balanced rather than strict parameter budget.

jobs.label: Asymmetric Pyramid Non-local Block
jobs.source: paddleseg/models/ann.py::APNB(256, 256, key_channels=64, value_channels=64, dropout_prob=0.05, repeat_sizes=[1], psp_size=(1,3,6,8)); forward(x)->x
jobs.purpose: Attend from every C4 location to a compact pyramid-pooled context set.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4
jobs.cost: medium-high parameters; attention memory is lower than full NonLocal because keys/values are pyramid pooled
jobs.risk: ANN's pooled sizes and dropout were designed for larger semantic objects; thin-crack gains are uncertain.
jobs.expected: A computationally safer global-attention alternative to PAM/NonLocal with better context coverage.

jobs.label: Asymmetric Fusion Non-local Block
jobs.source: paddleseg/models/ann.py::AFNB(low_in_channels=160, high_in_channels=256, out_channels=256, key_channels=64, value_channels=64, dropout_prob=0.05, repeat_sizes=[1], psp_size=(1,3,6,8)); forward(low_c3, high_c4)->x
jobs.purpose: Use pyramid-pooled C3 detail as keys/values to refine semantic C4 queries.
jobs.location: raw C3-to-C4 fusion before linear_c4
jobs.cost: medium-high; two-scale projections and pooled cross-attention
jobs.risk: It adds another cross-scale fusion before Aligned, so attribution may be harder and redundant fusion may suppress fine responses.
jobs.expected: Mechanistically complementary to Aligned because it fuses C3/C4 semantics while Aligned later fuses C1/C4 geometry.

jobs.label: FastFCN Joint Pyramid Upsampling
jobs.purpose: Fuse C2/C3/C4 at C2 resolution and apply four separable dilation branches.
jobs.location: replace raw C2 with JPU's fourth output before the standard C2 projection
jobs.cost: medium runtime at 1/8 resolution and about 64 output channels; separable dilated convolutions limit parameters
jobs.risk: This changes the C2 feature consumed by the decoder rather than applying a pure residual; dilation aliases may hurt narrow cracks.
jobs.expected: A multi-level context candidate with more spatial detail than C4-only modules and acceptable parameter growth.

jobs.label: DMNet Dynamic Convolutional Module
jobs.purpose: Generate an image-conditioned 3x3 depthwise filter for each C4 channel.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4
jobs.cost: medium; about three 256-to-256 pointwise projections plus grouped dynamic convolution
jobs.risk: Dynamic grouped convolution has backend-specific performance and export risk; one filter size tests DCM rather than the full four-branch DMNet head.
jobs.expected: May adapt smoothing to individual crack patterns, with moderate parameter growth and uncertain Windows latency.

jobs.label: Expectation-Maximization Attention Unit
jobs.source: paddleseg/models/emanet.py::EMAU(c=256, k=32, stage_num=3, momentum=0.1); forward(x)->reconstruction, used as relu(x+reconstruction)
jobs.purpose: Reconstruct C4 from a small learned basis set updated by EM iterations.
jobs.location: raw C4 residual before linear_c4
jobs.cost: very low trainable parameters but iterative matrix operations and mutable running bases
jobs.risk: Earlier C4 EMAU shifted recall up and precision down; the running buffer complicates EMA/checkpoint reproducibility.
jobs.expected: Useful diversity control, but lower priority because prior evidence showed an unfavorable operating-point shift.

jobs.label: Embedded-Gaussian Non-Local Block
jobs.purpose: Model dense all-to-all C4 pixel relations.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4
jobs.cost: medium; +66,752 parameters over W128 and quadratic spatial affinity
jobs.risk: Wave6 BF1 fell by 0.017070 versus B0 despite nearly matching crack-IoU; likely to thicken or fragment predictions.
jobs.expected: Only useful if Aligned corrects the known boundary weakness; do not advance on region metrics alone.

jobs.label: BiSeNetV1 Attention Refinement Module
jobs.purpose: Apply local 3x3 refinement followed by global channel gating on projected C4.
jobs.location: projected C4 at 1/32, immediately before AlignedModule
jobs.cost: medium; one 128-channel 3x3 convolution plus a 128-channel attention projection
jobs.risk: More parameters than SE and partially overlaps its channel-recalibration hypothesis; normalization on pooled features needs smoke verification.
jobs.expected: A mature local-plus-global refinement control that avoids the explicitly deferred Aligned+GC combination.

jobs.label: DANet Channel Attention Module
jobs.purpose: Reweight C4 channels using a channel-by-channel affinity matrix.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4
jobs.cost: negligible parameters and low-resolution channel-affinity compute
jobs.risk: Wave6 was almost identical to W128 and reduced BF1; the zero-initialized scale can remain near identity.
jobs.expected: Cheap control for whether Aligned exposes useful channel interactions.

jobs.label: Criss-Cross Attention
jobs.purpose: Aggregate long-range context along every feature-map row and column.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4
jobs.cost: medium; axial attention is cheaper than full HW-by-HW affinity
jobs.risk: Wave6 regional and boundary metrics remained below B0; grid-axis bias may not match curved cracks.
jobs.expected: Lower-priority structured-attention control.

jobs.label: DANet Position Attention Module
jobs.purpose: Apply dense spatial self-attention over C4 positions.
jobs.location: raw C4 before linear_c4
jobs.cost: medium; quadratic spatial affinity and about 82k added parameters in wave6
jobs.risk: Wave6 underperformed B0 and did not improve BF1; overlaps with NonLocal/DNL.
jobs.expected: Mechanism-completeness control rather than a likely finalist.

jobs.label: MSCAN Multi-Scale Convolutional Attention
jobs.purpose: Use depthwise strip convolutions at several large receptive fields on the fused decoder feature.
jobs.location: fused 1/4-resolution decoder feature after Aligned and linear_fuse
jobs.cost: medium-high runtime at 1/4 resolution; +63,616 parameters over W128 in wave6
jobs.risk: Wave6 reduced IoU/F1; large strip kernels may smooth thin structures and latency needs stable remeasurement.
jobs.expected: Spatial-context diversity test, unlikely to be the primary accuracy/efficiency choice.

jobs.label: PP-LiteSeg Channel-Attention UAFM
jobs.purpose: Refuse projected C1 detail and the Aligned decoder feature using learned channel gates.
jobs.location: post-linear_fuse at 1/4 resolution, inputs (_c1, fused_feature)
jobs.cost: high for this budget; +337,664 parameters over W128 in wave6
jobs.risk: Wave6 exceeded B0 parameters and was worse than Aligned on all primary region/boundary metrics.
jobs.expected: Retain only as a fusion-family control; normally stop after smoke/profile.

jobs.label: Polarized Self-Attention
jobs.purpose: Factor spatial and channel attention on the fused decoder feature.
jobs.location: fused 1/4-resolution decoder feature after Aligned and linear_fuse
jobs.cost: low parameters but attention reductions run at 1/4 resolution
jobs.risk: Wave6 reduced every headline metric and BF1; high-resolution reductions can add latency without benefit.
jobs.expected: Low-priority interaction control.

jobs.label: SegNeXt Hamburger NMF Context
jobs.purpose: Approximate long-range context through non-negative matrix factorization with fixed checkpointed bases.
jobs.location: projected C4 at 1/32, immediately before AlignedModule
jobs.cost: low parameters but six train/evaluation matrix-decomposition iterations
jobs.risk: The previous full LightHamHead was cheaper but less accurate; fixed-basis state must be materialized before checkpoint load.
jobs.expected: Exploratory low-parameter context test; prior head-level evidence argues against high priority.

jobs.label: MobileNetV3 Squeeze-and-Excitation
jobs.purpose: Apply lightweight global channel recalibration to the fused decoder feature.
jobs.location: fused 1/4-resolution decoder feature after Aligned and linear_fuse
jobs.cost: very low; two 1x1 channel bottleneck projections
jobs.risk: The latest 18k run ended by queue timeout near 3200 iterations, so there is no valid quality result; do not treat interruption as failure or resume with changed EMA/RNG state.
jobs.expected: Useful cheap baseline once rerun cleanly from the common seed/pretrained state.

jobs.label: PSPNet Pyramid Pooling Module
jobs.purpose: Concatenate fixed-grid pooled context scales before Aligned fusion.
jobs.location: projected C4 at 1/32, immediately before AlignedModule
jobs.cost: medium pooled-branch and bottleneck cost
jobs.risk: Not presently runnable on this stack: wave6 smoke backward reproduced CUDNN_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED. No full run until a source-neutral backend workaround is validated.
jobs.expected: Excluded from the executable queue for now; retained in the catalog as a documented incompatibility rather than a negative accuracy result.
jobs.skip_reason: Prior PSP backward cuDNN incompatibility; no performance result
